runbooks.title: Errors affecting only some requests
runbooks.content: Possible causes: a code regression in a recent release, bad input from one client, a feature flag, data-dependent bugs. Compare failing and succeeding requests, check the stack trace and the latest release notes.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: Release 5.0.3 introduced a null pointer bug in TaxCalculator: requests containing a shipping address outside the EU hit an unchecked null
